text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I run as my new self in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. It's the result of following a new training regimen designed for my growing body.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm worried about going up against so many cool big sisters like Bakushin O and Zephyr…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But Trainer says I'm just as cool as them! I'm sure I can blossom into an entirely different flower from the one I was before!
